messages.text: just got off work, feeling drained... like ugh

That 'ugh' feeling often signals that your body is asking for a break. It is completely understandable to feel drained after putting in a full day's work. What feels like the most gentle thing you can do for yourself right now?
like... i dunno. just had to smile and be polite all day even when people were kinda gross. feels fake after a while??

Maintaining a polite mask when you're feeling anything else is incredibly taxing. That sense of feeling fake is actually a very real signal that your authentic self is needing space. Many people find that emotional labor leaves them feeling hollow until they can decompress. Do you feel like you have any safe space right now to just drop the mask completely?
there was this older guy at the register... he leaned in real close and said my red hair looked “fire engine bright” or whatever. just — made me feel weird?? like, why’d he say that??

It sounds like that interaction felt invasive and uncomfortable for you. Questioning his intent is a very natural reaction when personal space is crossed. Your feeling of being "weirded out" is a valid signal that a boundary was stepped over. It makes sense that this specific moment added to the exhaustion you mentioned earlier.
yeah... i just laughed?? like i didn’t wanna make it a big deal or seem rude. but now i keep thinking — why didn’t i say something? feels stupid.

You aren't stupid for reacting that way; it was a survival tactic in the moment. Service work often forces us to prioritize politeness over our own comfort. Beating yourself up now only adds more weight to a day that was already heavy. Please try to offer yourself a little grace for handling that the best you could.
it just sucks bc i keep thinking he’s gonna come back or tell people or whatever. like, why did he say that?? feels so stupid to even care.

It is never stupid to care about your own comfort or safety. That worry is a natural response to feeling disrespected or unsafe. You did what you needed to do in the moment to keep things calm. How are you feeling in your body right now?
my chest feels kinda tight?? and i keep replaying it. what if he tells other people i work there? what if he comes back and it’s worse?? idk i’m probably overreacting but...

That tightness is a physical signal that your nervous system is still on high alert. You are not overreacting; your body is responding to a genuine feeling of discomfort. It is very common to worry about future safety after an unsettling encounter. Would you be willing to try a few slow breaths to help settle that tension?
is it normal to feel this worked up over something that wasn’t even that bad?? like, other people deal with worse...

It is completely normal to feel this way when your personal boundaries are crossed. Comparing your pain to others' doesn't make your experience any less real or valid. Your reaction is about how *you* felt unsafe, not about ranking the severity of bad interactions. Your discomfort matters regardless of what others might endure.
oh... okay. thanks. that actually helps a lot?? i’ve been feeling kinda crazy about it.

I am so glad you are feeling a bit more relief after that. Feeling "crazy" is a common reaction when your nervous system is overwhelmed by stress. You are not crazy, and you are allowed to have this reaction. Please remember to be gentle with yourself as you continue to decompress.

yeah... i keep thinking he’s gonna come back and say something worse. like, what if he waits for me after work?? what if he tells everyone i’m a freak?? idk it’s dumb but i can’t stop thinking about it

It is not dumb to feel this way when your safety feels uncertain. Your mind might be trying to protect you by imagining worst-case scenarios. You are allowed to take steps that make you feel more secure leaving work. Do you have a plan that helps you feel safer getting home tonight?
what if he’s outside right now?? what if he follows me home and tells my parents i’m a freak?? what if he tells my boyfriend?? i can’t even show my face at work tomorrow...

I hear how much fear and shame you are carrying right now. These thoughts can feel very real when anxiety is this high. You are not alone, and your physical safety is the priority. If you feel threatened, please contact someone you trust or local security before leaving.
i just... can’t stop thinking about it. feels like it’s gonna happen?? like, what if it does?? i don’t know what to do

I hear how overwhelming this fear feels, and it makes sense that you want to protect yourself. It is very hard to stay calm when your mind is racing with these possibilities. If you feel unsafe right now, please contact a trusted person or emergency services immediately. You do not have to face this worry alone.
no no i’m not in danger or whatever, i just... can’t stop thinking about it. feels so stupid but it’s stuck in my head??

It is not stupid to feel stuck in these thoughts, even when you know you are safe. Your brain is trying to protect you, even if the threat isn't actually there right now. Please be gentle with yourself for carrying this heavy mental load. Would you like to try shifting your focus to something physical around you right now?
thanks for not making me feel crazy... it helps just to say it out loud??

I am really glad that speaking out loud helped ease the burden. You are not crazy, and your feelings are completely valid. It takes strength to process these difficult moments on your own. Please remember to be gentle with yourself tonight.
